description_en: Sends a verification code to the secure phone number of a new management account when you call SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD to enable a resource directory by creating a new management account
description_zh: 通过创建新管理账号开通资源目录时，调用 SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD 向新管理账号的安全手机号码发送验证码
name: SendVerificationCodeForEnableRD

parameters.help_en:
The secure phone number of the new management account. If you leave this parameter empty, the secure phone number of the current logon account is used.

Format: `<Country code>-<Phone number>`.

<props="intl">
Phone numbers in the `86-<Phone number>` format from the Chinese mainland are not supported.</props>

<props="china">
Only phone numbers in the `86-<Phone number>` format from the Chinese mainland are supported.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
新创建的管理账号的安全手机号码。置空表示采用当前登录账号的安全手机号码。

格式：`<国家码>-<手机号码>`。

<props="intl">
不支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>

<props="china">
仅支持填写`86-<手机号码>`的中国内地手机号码。</props>
parameters.name: secure_mobile_phone
